full_text_zh:
[P1] 神奇糖果店
文/图：〔日〕宫西达也  翻译：朱自强
河北出版传媒集团
河北教育出版社

[P2] 神奇糖果店
有一天，小猪在森林里，
噔噔噔地走着、走着，
看见了一家神奇糖果店。
“狗獾叔叔，
神奇糖果是什么样的糖果啊？”

[P3] “这里的糖果，
含在嘴里就会发生神奇的事情。
来，这颗黄色的糖果，你试试看。”
“真……真的吗？”

[P4] 嗖
“嗯，好甜啊。”
可是，什么神奇的事儿也没发生。
小猪一边含着糖果，一边说：
“叔叔，这哪是神奇糖果啊！”
狗獾叔叔微笑着说：
“这块岩石，你来举举看。”
“不……不可能，这么大的岩石……”
小猪一边说，一边去搬。

[P5] 结果，小猪轻松地举了起来。
“哇！真……真厉害啊！
真的是神奇糖果啊。”
“没骗你吧？是很神奇吧？
这一颗是大力士糖果啊。”

[P6] 可是，小猪吃完糖果，再去搬岩石——
“哎哎哎……”
小猪脸都憋红了，岩石却纹丝不动。
“糖果一吃完，功效就没了。
小猪，接下来这颗蓝糖果，
可真是不得了啊！”

说着，狗獾叔叔把糖果放进小猪嘴里。

可是，小猪含了糖果，什么事也没发生。
狗獾叔叔就说：
“小猪，你大声喊喊看。”
就在小猪打算大声呼喊时——

[P7] “含了这颗糖果，
就能发出狮子的吼声。”
“嗷，嗷嗷——真厉害！”
小猪很吃惊。

不过，小猪吃光了糖果之后，
“哼，哼，哼——”
发出的仍然是以前的哼哼声。

“小猪，接下来这颗绿糖果，可真是厉害啊！”
说着，狗獾叔叔把糖果放进小猪嘴里。
结果——

[P8] 小猪竟然一点儿一点儿地消失了。
“原来吃了它，能隐身啊。
真厉害！真厉害！”
小猪高兴坏了。

在哪儿呢？

不过，一吃光糖果，小猪又变回来了。
“小猪，下一颗糖果才真叫厉害呢。”

狗獾叔叔把一颗红糖果放进小猪嘴里。

[P9] 这一次，小猪竟……竟然变成了大灰狼。
“怎么样，这颗糖果厉害吧？”
“真厉害啊！叔叔，请给我三颗红糖果，一颗绿糖果。”
狗獾叔叔把糖果放进瓶子里。

“这颗糖果白送你了。你遇到了困难，
一含着它，就会发生让人吃惊的事情。”
说着，狗獾叔叔把白糖果也放了进去。

“狗獾叔叔，谢谢您。”
小猪道了谢，笑眯眯地走了。
“好嘞，来一场恶作剧吧。”
小猪把三颗红糖果
一下子塞进嘴里。

[P10] 小猪变成了大灰狼，
跑去吓唬大家。
“嘿嘿嘿……我是大灰狼！”
“嘿嘿嘿……我要吃了你们！”
“吓死人了！大灰狼来了！”
“救命啊！”
大家边喊边逃。

“嘿嘿嘿……他们没有认出我，
以为我真是大灰狼。”
就在这时——

[P11] “不行，不行，太差劲儿了！
像你这样，别说兔子，
连老鼠都抓不住！”
一只真的大灰狼
从树后跳了出来。

小猪不由自主地说道：
“那……那该怎么做啊？”

“跟我来，我教你。”
大灰狼根本没有察觉，
这只狼是小猪变的。

“请……请多关照。”
小猪嘴上这样说着，
身体却吓得发抖，想赶快逃跑。
而他随后被带到的地方，竟然是——

[P12] 大灰狼镇！到处都是大灰狼。
“好像有小猪的气味！”
“是吃起来很香的那种气味。”
“是从这儿发出来的，从这儿……”
大灰狼们不断地向小猪围拢过来。
就在这时——

[P13] 哎呀呀，
小猪的尾巴变回来了。
“喂，这家伙好奇怪啊！”
“这家伙有一股小猪的气味。”
“真可疑……”

[P14] 不只是尾巴，
小猪的手、脚和身体都变了回来。
“不好！”
小猪急忙把绿糖果塞进嘴里。
于是——

[P15] 小猪的身体变得透明，
大灰狼们看不见他了。
“嘿嘿嘿，趁这工夫赶快逃吧。”
可是——

[P16] 因为气味，小猪被发现了。
接着，嘴里的糖果化光以后，
小猪变回了原来的样子。
“嘿嘿嘿，抓住他了。”
小猪心想：“这下完了！”
他想起狗獾叔叔说的话：
含上白糖果，就会发生让人吃惊的事情。
于是他把白糖果放进嘴里。
结果——

[P17] 呜哇——
小猪的身体
竟然噌噌噌地变大了！

[P18] “救命啊！”
大灰狼们大喊着，
从小猪的胯下逃走了。

小猪放下心来，说道：
“这糖果真的很神奇，很厉害……
不过，还是普通的糖果好啊。”
说完，就嘿嘿嘿地笑了起来。
full_text_en:
[P1] The Magical Candy Shop
Text and Illustrations: [Japan] Tatsuya Miura  Translator: Zhu Ziqiang
Hebei Publishing and Media Group
Hebei Education Press

[P2] Magical Candy Shop
One day, the little pig was walking in the forest,
clomping along, clomping along,
and saw a magical candy shop.
"Uncle Badger,
what kind of candy are the magical candies?"

[P3] "The candies here,
if you put them in your mouth, will cause magical things to happen.
Come on, try this yellow candy."
"Really... really?"

[P4] Whoosh
"Hmm, so sweet."
But nothing magical happened.
While sucking on the candy, the little pig said:
"Uncle, this isn't a magical candy at all!"
The badger uncle smiled and said:
"This rock, try lifting it."
"No... impossible, such a big rock..."
The little pig said while trying to lift it.

[P5] As a result, the little pig lifted it easily.
"Wow! Really... amazing!
It's really a magical candy."
"Didn't I trick you? It's really magical, right?
This one is the Super Strength Candy."

[P6] But after the little pig finished the candy and tried to move the rock—
"Ah-ah-ah..."
His face turned red, but the rock didn't budge.
"Once the candy is gone, the effect disappears.
Little pig, this next blue candy—
well, it's something special!"

Saying that, Uncle Dog獾 put the candy into the little pig's mouth.

But after the little pig held the candy in his mouth, nothing happened.
Uncle Dog獾 said:
"Little pig, shout out loud!"
Just as the little pig was about to shout loudly—

[P7] "Chew this candy, and you'll be able to roar like a lion."
"Roar, roar—so amazing!" 
The piglet was very surprised.

However, after the piglet finished the candy,
"Hmph, hmph, hmph—"
he still made the same old squeaking sound.

"Piglet, next up is this green candy—truly amazing!"
Saying that, Uncle Badger put the candy into the piglet's mouth.
And then—

[P8] The little pig disappeared bit by bit.
"So this makes you invisible! Wow! Wow!"
The little pig was overjoyed.

Where is he?

But as soon as he finished the candy, the little pig reappeared.
"Little pig, the next candy is truly amazing."

The badger uncle put a red candy into the little pig's mouth.

[P9] This time, the little pig... actually turned into a big gray wolf.
"How is it? Isn't this candy amazing?"
"It's amazing! Uncle, give me three red candies and one green candy."
The badger uncle put the candies into the bottle.

"This candy is a free gift for you. If you're in trouble,
just hold it in your mouth, and something surprising will happen."
Saying that, the badger uncle also put the white candy into the bottle.

"Thank you, Uncle Badger."
The little pig said thank you and walked away with a smile.
"Alright, let's play a prank."
The little pig stuffed all three red candies
into his mouth at once.

[P10] The little pig turned into a big gray wolf,
and ran off to scare everyone.
"Hehehe... I'm the big gray wolf!"
"Hehehe... I'm going to eat you!"
"Oh no! The big gray wolf is coming!"
"Help!"
Everyone screamed and ran away.

"Hehehe... They didn't recognize me,
they thought I was really the big gray wolf."
Just then —

[P11] "No, no, you're terrible!
With you like this, you can't even catch a rabbit,
let alone a mouse!"
A real big gray wolf
jumped out from behind the tree.

The little pig said involuntarily:
"Well... what should I do?"

"Come with me, I'll teach you."
The big gray wolf didn't notice at all,
this wolf was actually the little pig transformed.

"Please... please take care of me."
The little pig said that, but
his body trembled with fear, wanting to run away quickly.
And the place he was then taken to was ——

[P12] Wolf Town! Everywhere are wolves.
"It smells like pig!"
"The kind that tastes delicious!"
"It's coming from here, from here..."
The wolves keep closing in on the pig.
Just then —

[P13] Oh no,
the pig's tail has changed back.
"Hey, this guy is really strange!"
"This guy smells like a pig."
"Really suspicious..."

[P14] Not just the tail,
the pig's hands, feet, and body changed back.
"Oh no!"
The pig quickly stuffed the green candy into his mouth.
Then ——

[P15] Piglet's body became transparent,
the big gray wolves couldn't see him.
"Hehehe, now's the time to run away quickly."
But ——

[P16] Because of the smell, the piglet was discovered.
Then, after the candy in his mouth melted away,
the piglet turned back into his original form.
"Hehehe, we've got him!"
The piglet thought: "This is it!"
He remembered what Uncle Badger had said:
If you put the white candy in your mouth, something surprising will happen.
So he put the white candy in his mouth.
The result —

[P17] Whoa—
The piglet's body
was suddenly growing bigger and bigger!

[P18] "Help!"
The big gray wolves shouted,
and fled under the little pig's legs.

The little pig relaxed and said:
"This candy is really magical and powerful...
But still, ordinary candy is better."
Then he laughed, "Hehehe!"
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《神奇糖果店》的封面，展示了一只微笑的粉色小恐龙手持糖果瓶，背景是森林，上方有书名、作者和出版社信息。
[P2] 小猪在森林里散步时，发现了一家名为“神奇糖果店”的店铺，并好奇地向店里的狗獾叔叔询问神奇糖果是什么样的糖果。
[P3] 狗獾叔叔向小猪介绍神奇糖果，并递给他一颗黄色的糖果，小猪表示怀疑。
[P4] 小猪吃了黄色糖果后觉得甜，但未发生神奇变化，于是质疑糖果的神奇性。狗獾叔叔让他尝试举起一块大岩石，小猪对此表示怀疑并准备去搬。
[P5] 小猪吃下神奇糖果后，轻松举起了大岩石，狗獾叔叔解释这是大力士糖果，小猪感到惊讶并确认了糖果的神奇效果。
[P6] 小猪吃完第一颗神奇糖果后无法搬动岩石，狗獾叔叔解释效果已消失，并递给他一颗蓝色糖果。小猪含着蓝糖果却无反应，狗獾叔叔让他大声喊叫，故事在小猪准备呼喊时暂停。
[P7] 小猪含下蓝色糖果后发出狮子般的吼声，但吃完后声音恢复原样。狗獾叔叔随后递给他一颗绿色糖果，故事在小猪准备尝试时暂停。
[P8] 小猪吃了隐身糖果后消失，随后又因糖果效果消失而重新出现，狗獾叔叔随即递给他一颗红色的糖果准备继续体验神奇效果。
[P9] 小猪在神奇糖果店体验了变身糖果的效果，变成大灰狼后向狗獾叔叔要了三颗红糖果和一颗绿糖果。狗獾叔叔又赠送了一颗白糖果，并解释其用途。小猪道谢离开，准备用红糖果恶作剧，将三颗红糖果一下子塞进嘴里。
[P10] 小猪吃下变身糖果后变成大灰狼，在森林里吓唬其他小动物，大家惊慌逃跑；小猪得意地发现没人认出他，正当他享受恶作剧时，故事在‘就在这时——’处暂停。
[P11] 小猪变身成大灰狼在森林里吓唬其他动物，一只真正的狼出现并嘲笑他，小猪感到害怕，被真正的狼带往一个未知的地方。
[P12] 小猪变身成大灰狼后，误入一个全是狼的小镇，被众多大灰狼围住，它们闻到小猪的气味并围拢过来，故事在紧张时刻暂停。
[P13] 小猪变身成大灰狼后，被一群真正的狼围住，它们发现他尾巴变回原样并闻到小猪气味，开始怀疑他的身份。
[P14] 小猪变身大灰狼后被一群狼围住，尾巴变回原样暴露身份，他急忙吃下绿糖果试图恢复，故事在紧张时刻暂停。
[P15] 小猪吃下白糖果后身体变得透明，躲过了大灰狼们的围攻，正准备逃跑时，故事在‘可是——’处暂停。
[P16] 小猪因气味被狼群发现，糖果化光后变回原样，被狼群围住。他想起狗獾叔叔的话，吃下白糖果，身体变得透明，正准备逃跑时故事暂停。
[P17] 小猪的身体突然变大，周围的小动物们惊慌地四散逃跑。
[P18] 小猪变身成大灰狼吓唬其他动物，狼群惊慌逃走，小猪得意地认为糖果很神奇，但觉得普通糖果更好，开心地笑了。
[P19] 页面为绘本末尾的版权页，中央绘有一只獾站在柜台后，柜台上摆放着多个装有彩色糖果的玻璃罐，右下角有ISBN条形码和定价信息，左上角有出版社和绿色食品标识。
